name: Nova Onas
bio: Nova Onas is a Filipino-Australian actress born and raised in the Philippines. She has been based in Sydney, Australia since 2018. From 2019, she has pursued her various passion in the areas of acting, modeling & fashion photography and videography.

credits.title: Echo 8 Beyond
credits.overview: After the occurrences of 'Echo 8,' Anna finds herself pursued by lethal Zodiac operatives tasked with her termination. Living off-grid, she shields her mother from a distance. However, her identity is exposed when she crosses paths with a group of misfits.

credits.title: The Fall Guy
credits.overview: Fresh off an almost career-ending accident, stuntman Colt Seavers has to track down a missing movie star, solve a conspiracy and try to win back the love of his life while still doing his day job.

credits.title: Echo 8
credits.overview: An assassin flashes between a nightmarish dream and her reality at a secret underground organization. When her latest mission involves killing a grieving mother, she discovers her target is closer to home than she realizes.
